summary:
GIPHY is the GIF search site at giphy.com. The black wordmark in the tab is the icon search bookmarks show, with the format read from the file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against giphy.com. HTML came from https://giphy.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://giphy.com/static/img/favicon.png; apple-touch-icon 120x120 → https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-120px.png; apple-touch-icon 180x180 → https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-180px.png; apple-touch-icon 152x152 → https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-152px.png; apple-touch-icon 167x167 → https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-167px.png.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://giphy.com/favicon.ico returned png (16×16, 1197 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-180px.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #111111 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 2126 bytes) from https://giphy.com/static/img/icons/apple-touch-icon-180px.png.
